command: set -euo pipefail; LA="$HOME/local-agent"; echo '=== LOCAL_AGENT ==='; git -C "$LA" branch --show-current; git -C "$LA" rev-parse HEAD; git -C "$LA" status --short; echo '=== REGISTRY ==='; python3 -c 'import json,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path.home()/"Library/Application Support/local-agent/repositories.json"; x=json.loads(p.read_text()); [print(r.get("id"), "repository="+str(r.get("repository")), "legacy_workspace="+str(r.get("legacy_workspace",False)), "control="+str(r.get("control_dir")), "work="+str(r.get("work_dir")), "checkpoints="+str(r.get("checkpoints_dir"))) for r in x["repositories"] if r.get("enabled",True)]'; echo '=== LAUNCHD ==='; launchctl print "gui/$(id -u)/com.michal.local-agent" | sed -n '1,120p'; echo '=== CANONICAL DOC DRIFT SEARCH ==='; cd "$LA"; grep -RInE 'Global execution concurrency is one|global execution concurrency one|agent-workspace/control|agent-workspace/work|agent-workspace/checkpoints|com\.michal\.local-agent\.plist|Current release:|v4\.11\.1' AGENTS.md README.md docs --exclude-dir=history || true
